question: Which bank has been assigned the Lead Bank responsibility for the newly created district of Old Delhi?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000007 states: "1. Old Delhi Canara Bank 03E (to be read as 'Numeral Zero, Numeral Three and Alphabet E')".

question: What Lead Bank action was taken regarding Shahdara district following the re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000013 explains that as Shahdara district has ceased to exist, the Lead Bank responsibility notified in respect of the district vide circular dated July 11, 2013 stands revoked.

question: From what date does Chapter IV on Minimum Capital Requirements for Operational Risk come into effect under the Commercial Banks Forthcoming Instructions Second Amendment?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000033 (Clause 3(ii)) specifies that Chapter IV of the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Directions, 2025, on Minimum Capital Requirements for Operational Risk, along with amendments, comes into effect from April 1, 2027.

question: How many years of operational risk annual loss data must be used to calculate average losses in the Loss Component for ILM?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000074 (substituting Paragraph 32) states that the calculation of average losses in the Loss Component (LC) shall be based on 10 years of high-quality operational risk annual loss data.

question: At what administrative level must rejection of SC/ST loan applications under government programmes be decided?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000139 (Clause 2.7) states that rejection of SC/STs' loan applications under government programmes should be done at the next higher level instead of at the branch level, with reasons clearly indicated.

question: Are commercial banks permitted to insist on deposits from SC/ST borrowers when evaluating loan applications under government-sponsored poverty alleviation schemes?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000136 (Clause 2.4) states that banks should not insist on deposits while considering loan applications under government-sponsored poverty alleviation schemes/self-employment programmes from borrowers belonging to SCs/STs.

question: Which external commission representative should the SLBC Convenor bank invite to attend State Level Bankers Committee meetings regarding SC/ST credit?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000149 (Clause 6.4) states that the SLBC Convenor bank should invite the representative of the National Commission for SCs/STs to attend SLBC meetings, and may also invite representatives from NSFDC and State SC/ST Corporations.

question: What minimum leverage ratio must be maintained by a Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB)?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000253 (Paragraph 262(2)) mandates that the minimum leverage ratio for a domestic systemically important bank (D-SIB) shall be 4 per cent and 3.5 per cent for other banks.

question: How is the Basel III leverage ratio mathematically defined in terms of capital and exposure measures?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000252 (Paragraph 262(1)) defines the Basel III leverage ratio as the capital measure (numerator) divided by the exposure measure (denominator), expressed as a percentage.

question: On what frequency basis are the capital measure and exposure measure required to be calculated for the leverage ratio framework?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000259 (Paragraph 262(5)) specifies that both the capital measure and the exposure measure are to be calculated on a quarter-end basis, with more frequent calculations subject to RBI approval.

question: अनुसूचित जातियों और अनुसूचित जनजातियों के लिए ऋण सुविधाओं से संबंधित मास्टर परिपत्र रिज़र्व बैंक के किस विभाग द्वारा जारी किया गया है?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000125 contains bilingual Hindi/English letterhead explicitly naming "ि व त् त ीय समावेशन और िवकास िवभाग" (Financial Inclusion & Development Department) and "भारतीय रज़वर् बैंक".

question: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक के विनियमन विभाग का केंद्रीय कार्यालय मुंबई में किस मार्ग पर स्थित है?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000030 contains Devanagari text specifying: "िविनयमन िवभाग, कें द्र ी य कायार्लय... शहीद भगत िसंह मागर्, फोटर्, मुंबई - 400001".

question: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के पूंजी पर्याप्तता संबंधी 11वें संशोधन निर्देशों के पत्र-शीर्ष पर कौन सा राष्ट्रीय नारा मुद्रित है?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000248 letterhead opens with the Devanagari text: "बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ भारतीय रज़वर् बैंक".

question: सरकारी कार्यक्रमों के अंतर्गत अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के ऋण आवेदनों को अस्वीकार करने का निर्णय किस स्तर पर लिया जाना चाहिए?
candidate_explanation: Cross-lingual semantic match: CLS-0000139 (Clause 2.7) prescribes that rejection of SC/ST loan applications under government programmes must be done at the next higher level instead of branch level.

question: घरेलू प्रणालीगत रूप से महत्वपूर्ण बैंकों (D-SIBs) के लिए न्यूनतम उत्तोलन अनुपात (leverage ratio) कितने प्रतिशत निर्धारित किया गया है?
candidate_explanation: Cross-lingual semantic match: CLS-0000253 (Paragraph 262(2)) specifies that the minimum leverage ratio for a domestic systemically important bank (D-SIB) shall be 4 per cent.

question: What specific classification is granted to loans sanctioned to State Sponsored Organisations for SCs/STs under Clause 2.6?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000138 (Clause 2.6.) specifies that loans sanctioned to State Sponsored Organisations for SCs/STs for purchasing/supplying inputs or marketing outputs are eligible for priority sector classification.

question: What role is assigned to the District Level Consultative Committees under Clause 1.1 of the Master Circular?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000127 (Clause 1.1) states that District Level Consultative Committees formed under the Lead Bank Scheme should continue to be the principal mechanism of co-ordination between banks and development agencies.

question: What leverage ratio requirement is imposed on a branch of a Global Systemically Important Bank (G-SIB) in India under Paragraph 262(2)?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000253 (Clause (2) under Paragraph 262) states that a G-SIB branch in India shall maintain a leverage ratio of 3.5 per cent plus the leverage ratio buffer applicable to it as a G-SIB.

question: What requirement is mandated for banks at all times under Paragraph 262(6)?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000260 (Clause (6) under Paragraph 262) states: "(6) A bank shall meet the minimum leverage ratio requirement at all times."

question: What does Paragraph 4(iv) substituting Paragraph 32 mandate regarding the historical time horizon of loss data used in the Loss Component calculation?
candidate_explanation: CLS-0000074 (Clause (iv) substituting Paragraph 32) states: "The calculation of average losses in the LC shall be based on 10 years of highquality operational risk annual loss data."
